about_the_game:
80's Retro-style space game designed for kids but fun for the whole family!

3 levels of difficulty:

Cupcake Galaxy = Relaxed cupcake hunting for the youngest players! Includes 3 fun progressively harder bosses as you advance your score. You must beat the end boss to win!

Ice Cream Land = A faster paced shooting game for experienced kiddos! Includes 3 tougher bosses as your score grows. You must beat the end boss to win! Grab chocolate syrup bottles for +250 bonus points and cans of whipped cream for +800 bonus points!

Donut World = This is a fast-spawning donut extravaganza for advanced young players! 30 second time limit! Grab white milk for +10 seconds and chocolate milk for +30 seconds on the timer! Grab a coffee for 10 seconds of invincibility! If you quit the level, you must have over 25,000 points to win! If your timer runs out, over 25,000 points wins! Keep getting power ups to get to the highest on the leaderboard!

A universal powerup will appear occasionally in all 3 levels. An orange gummy bear will restore 1 life when you grab it to a maximum of 6.

Using a mobile device has intuitive and obvious controls. If you are playing on pc or a tablet with a keyboard and prefer the keyboard experience but you have a touchscreen, then using the settings menu will allow you to hide mobile controls, or silence sound effects or music.

Using a keyboard, controls are as follows:

A = left

D = right

W = Go

Spacebar = Fire Bullets

You can also click on-screen buttons with the mouse, but this isn’t recommended for the best playing experience.

May the best space shooter win! See you at the top!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS (or equivalent) / SteamOS 3.0 (Arch-based)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 380 (with Vulkan support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible GPU drivers (e.g., NVIDIA 390.xx or later, AMD Mesa 18.0 or later). SteamOS 3.0 (used on Steam Deck) is based on Arch Linux; ensure compatibility with Proton if using Steam. SSD recommended for optimal performance. Ensure OpenGL 4.5 or Vulkan 1.1 support for graphics.
